svg.text: The logical view: what the machine is, independent of where it runs. Traces to SystemDesign §2–§9 · Design §1–§4
Six invariants — a design that violates one is wrong regardless of how well it works

g.text: The agent never runs against a past date
Models do judgment only; every computable number is computed
Prediction is a departure from a baseline, never a price
Nothing enters a prompt with knowledge_time after the cut-off
Every wiki observation carries seeded / observed provenance
The run manifest is written last

svg.text: Three tiers. The word "agent" applies to exactly one — and it is empty.
Ingest · validation · pre-filter · features · scoring · page statistics
Prompt assembled by code. One call, structured output.
No tools, no loop, no choice about what to read.
Has tools, runs its own loop, decides its own next step
Agency was examined and declined (ADR-0041). The curator's four proposed tools
collapsed: three were replaceable, the fourth did not fix its own target risk.
Two lanes — conflating them is the fastest way to misread the risk
History feeds exactly three things (ADR-0037): Lane A calibration · the deterministic wiki seed · threshold calibration.
It is never replayed through the agent. Lane A's historical numbers are labelled calibration, never compared against the agent.
The head-to-head happens live, on identical days, for all six rungs — and only there.
Two import rules enforced in CI, not by review (Design §1)
No storage client imported outside ingest/ and repository/
No model client outside events/, predict/ and wiki/ — ADR-0004's line as a lint
The daily loop — how knowledge accretes
Statistics three ways: seeded · observed · combined.
A null result is a valid and
features reach the predictor directly, not only through the numeric tracks
Score → curator appends the observation and says what it means → code recomputes the posterior → the predictor reads a different
number tomorrow. Four things drive it: the evidence base grows, the interval tightens, the curator can rewrite a hypothesis that stops
holding, and the nightly sweep surfaces grid cells the data supports but no page covers.
Blind spot: it cannot see errors that belong to the predictor rather than to any correlation.
"The model says 0.70 and that bucket occurs 45% of the time" is invisible to every page's hit rate — overconfidence is spread across all
of them. Closed two ways: prompt block 6b (its own reliability, directional balance, departure discipline — all arithmetic), and a nightly
isotonic map applied mechanically, so the correction does not depend on the model choosing to act on what it read.
The 5 → 6 gap should shrink. If it does, the model is learning from its own record; if flat, the mechanical layer is carrying it.
Controls — what makes a null result believable
The harness is a first-class deliverable, not test tooling. Each control targets a specific way the result could be wrong.

svg.text: Why scoring contains no model call, ever (REQ-801)

A model that scores can grade its own homework, and the project's stated success criterion is that a null result is believable. The too-good-to-be-true trip also depends on it: that inference only holds
if the scorer is incapable of being generous. And scores must be reproducible forever — the learning curve compares day 400 against day 40, so a drifting scorer would measure the scorer.
Provenance — finer-grained than a single tag
A human does not generate observations; writing evidence rows would be fabricating data.
Steering — four verbs, Cognito-authenticated, fully audited: flag · propose · edit · correct. A correction keeps the row's source tag and adds corrected_by.
Two skill series are always reported together — agent-authored pages versus human-touched pages.
A correct prediction citing a human-written hypothesis is not the agent having learned anything. The published audit trail is what makes steering self-policing.
Bitemporal data model — and why it survives forward-only
Every record carries event_time (when it happened) and knowledge_time (the earliest we could have known it). Revisions append; nothing is updated in place.
Under forward-only this is no longer used to reconstruct the past. It is what makes scoring correct: a t+5 prediction matures five days later and
must be scored against what was known at t, which requires the record to say so. That is a recording obligation — far easier to satisfy than a reconstruction one.
knowledge_time cannot be retrofitted onto populated stores, which is why the schema is built first and nothing else may precede it.
Wiki versioning is S3 object versioning plus a per-run manifest recording every page's version_id. Every prediction cites pages by path@version_id,
so any forecast can be replayed against exactly the knowledge that produced it — which is what makes the audit trail real rather than nominal.
Stores: S3 (raw, wiki, parquet, cassettes, snapshots, published) · DynamoDB (predictions, scores, runs, events, features, steering) · Athena (range scans)
Read with: SystemDesign.md §2.1 (agency boundary), §5 (three tracks), §6 (the wiki), §8 (evaluation) · Design.md §1–§4 (modules, schemas, algorithms) · prediction-contract.md (prompt + output schema)
The product is the wiki and the measurement. Scraping exists to feed them; the pipeline exists to make them meaningful.

g.text: Nothing in this diagram is an agent. Tier 3 stays empty deliberately until ADR-0041 is superseded.
